instruction.text: Look at the <t-cyan>blue sum</t-cyan> and choose its <t-purple>inverse sum</t-purple>.

hint.text: The inverse sum contains the opposite operation to the original sum. If the original sum is an addition, the inverse sum will be a subtraction.
Compare the numbers in the <t-cyan>original calculation</t-cyan> and in the <t-purple>inverse calculation</t-purple>.

instruction.text: How does the <t-purple>inverse sum</t-purple> show that the <t-cyan>blue sum</t-cyan> was solved incorrectly?

b: ++The answer to the inverse sum is a number that is not in the original sum.
The numbers in the original sum were multiples of two.
